observations: Photo shows a PlayStation 4 DualShock-style controller (blue/pink face buttons) placed on top of a PS4 console box/cover.
No clear photo of the PS4 console itself (no front ports, disc drive area, or model label visible).
No visible storage size, firmware/version, or any game discs/cases in the photo.
Seller text claims it is a PS4 fat with FC26 and multiple games, but none of that is shown in the photo.

claims.claim: Ps4 fat hacked with fc26 and 8 other games
claims.evidence: Photo 0 only shows a controller on a box/cover; no PS4 fat unit, no FC26/firmware indicator, and no proof of the 8 games.

risks.risk: The item may not be a PS4 fat console (could be only a controller or a different PS4 model).
risks.proof: A photo of the actual console front/back plus a close-up of the model label/serial sticker (or the underside label).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed PS4 fat (worst case: treat as controller-only / non-matching item value).

risks.risk: Hacked/FC26 status may be false or not functional (or may be a different firmware/region).
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and a settings/system info screen that indicates the relevant firmware/version, plus confirmation of the hack environment.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/unknown software state (worst case: treat as standard console with no confirmed hack benefits).

risks.risk: The claimed 8 games may not be included, may be unplayable, or may be digital-only with account issues.
risks.proof: Photos of all game discs/cases (or screenshots of the game library with visible titles) and a short clip launching 1 game to the main menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (no confirmed games).

risks.risk: Hardware condition (disc drive, HDMI port, Wi‑Fi, controller pairing, overheating) is unknown.
risks.proof: A short test video: console powers on, loads a game/menu, audio/video output on TV, and controller works reliably.
risks.if_unproven: Price as hardware untested (worst case: assume faults until proven).

proof_requests: Photo of the actual PS4 console (front + back ports) and a close-up of the model/serial label.
Video of the console booting and showing system information (firmware/version) and that it is the claimed FC26 state.
Proof of games: either photos of all discs/cases or screenshots of the library with titles visible; then a clip launching one game.
response.reason: The only photo shows a controller on a box/cover; there is no visible PS4 fat console, no FC26/firmware evidence, and no proof of the claimed games. Without these, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
